methodology.returns: Rn = 100*(close[t]/close[t-n]-1), RS n = own Rn minus benchmark Rn, in percentage points. Benchmark prices must cover matching stock endpoint dates.
methodology.benchmark_identity: KOSPI stocks ^KS11; KOSDAQ stocks ^KQ11; US ^GSPC; JP 1306.T TOPIX-tracking ETF proxy, not actual TOPIX index return.
methodology.rs_acceleration5_pp: RS5 of latest 5 sessions minus RS5 of immediately preceding nonoverlapping 5 sessions; positive is relative-strength acceleration, not a forecast.
methodology.rs5_minus_quarter_rs20_pp: Latest RS5 minus RS20/4; a length-normalized descriptive comparison only.
methodology.vol_ratio_prior20: Latest daily shares volume divided by average of previous 20 sessions, excluding latest session.
methodology.volume_avg5_over_previous20: Average volume of latest 5 sessions divided by average of 20 sessions immediately before those 5 sessions.
methodology.estimated_turnover: Close times reported volume in local currency. This is an estimate, not exchange-reported actual traded value, and is not directly comparable across currencies.
methodology.estimated_turnover_avg5_over_previous20: Average close*volume of latest 5 sessions divided by average close*volume of preceding 20 nonoverlapping sessions.
methodology.breakout: A close is above the maximum HIGH of its preceding 20 completed sessions. first_close_breakout_dates_last10 records only event days in last 10 where this was true but previous session was not above its own preceding-20 maximum high.
methodology.close_range_position: (close-low)/(high-low), 0 near low and 1 near high; null for zero range.
methodology.updays_volume_fraction_last5: Volume on positive close-to-previous-close sessions in latest 5 divided by all volume in latest 5; flat sessions are not up days.
methodology.atr14: Simple average of last 14 true ranges, matching prior independent research calculation.
methodology.reuse: Original completed-session series revalidated locally within 24h retains original source checked_at. Reuse validation time must not be presented as a new source retrieval.
methodology.old_anomalies: Original provider anomalous old dates remain explicitly disclosed. Fresh latest completed anomalies fail; fresh in-window exclusions above 2 fail, consistent with approximately 1% tolerance.

attention_metric_definitions.purpose: Descriptive supplementary discovery evidence; no PHP numerical or buy-stage policy change.
attention_metric_definitions.returns: Rn = 100*(close[t]/close[t-n]-1), RS n = own Rn minus benchmark Rn, in percentage points. Benchmark prices must cover matching stock endpoint dates.
attention_metric_definitions.benchmark_identity: KOSPI stocks ^KS11; KOSDAQ stocks ^KQ11; US ^GSPC; JP 1306.T TOPIX-tracking ETF proxy, not actual TOPIX index return.
attention_metric_definitions.rs_acceleration5_pp: RS5 of latest 5 sessions minus RS5 of immediately preceding nonoverlapping 5 sessions; positive is relative-strength acceleration, not a forecast.
attention_metric_definitions.rs5_minus_quarter_rs20_pp: Latest RS5 minus RS20/4; a length-normalized descriptive comparison only.
attention_metric_definitions.vol_ratio_prior20: Latest daily shares volume divided by average of previous 20 sessions, excluding latest session.
attention_metric_definitions.volume_avg5_over_previous20: Average volume of latest 5 sessions divided by average of 20 sessions immediately before those 5 sessions.
attention_metric_definitions.estimated_turnover: Close times reported volume in local currency. This is an estimate, not exchange-reported actual traded value, and is not directly comparable across currencies.
attention_metric_definitions.estimated_turnover_avg5_over_previous20: Average close*volume of latest 5 sessions divided by average close*volume of preceding 20 nonoverlapping sessions.
attention_metric_definitions.breakout: A close is above the maximum HIGH of its preceding 20 completed sessions. first_close_breakout_dates_last10 records only event days in last 10 where this was true but previous session was not above its own preceding-20 maximum high.
attention_metric_definitions.close_range_position: (close-low)/(high-low), 0 near low and 1 near high; null for zero range.
attention_metric_definitions.updays_volume_fraction_last5: Volume on positive close-to-previous-close sessions in latest 5 divided by all volume in latest 5; flat sessions are not up days.
attention_metric_definitions.atr14: Simple average of last 14 true ranges, matching prior independent research calculation.
attention_metric_definitions.reuse: Original completed-session series revalidated locally within 24h retains original source checked_at. Reuse validation time must not be presented as a new source retrieval.
attention_metric_definitions.old_anomalies: Original provider anomalous old dates remain explicitly disclosed. Fresh latest completed anomalies fail; fresh in-window exclusions above 2 fail, consistent with approximately 1% tolerance.
